test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What will be the ratio of the simple interest on Rs. 1,000 for 2 years at 5% per annum to the simple interest on the same sum for the same period at 10% per annum?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Simple interest on Rs. 1,000 for 2 years at 5% per annum

Simple interest on the same sum for the same period at 10% per annum

**FORMULA USED:**

Interest = (Ptimes Rtimes T)/(100)

Where P = The amount lent

R = Interest at the amount lent

T = Year amount lent for

**CALCULATIONS:- **

Firstly SI of the amount lent at 5%

⇒ Interest1 = (Ptimes Rtimes T)/(100)=(1000times 5times 2)/(100)=Rs. 100

Firstly SI of the amount lent at 5%

⇒ Interest2 = (Ptimes Rtimes T)/(100)=(1000×10times 2)/(100)=Rs. 200

⇒ The ratio of SI of the amount lent at 5% to SI of the amount lent at = Interest1: Interest2 = 100: 200 = 1: 2

**Hence, The ratio of SI of the amount lent at 5% to SI of the amount lent at 10% is 1:2**
